user.title: TP-Link Powerline
user.description: Enter the IP address of your powerline adapter.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the powerline adapter
data_description.name: A friendly name for this powerline network
data_description.password: The admin password for the device's web portal (optional)

confirm_ping_only.title: Incompatible Device
confirm_ping_only.description: This device's web portal is not compatible with this integration. You can continue with ping-only monitoring (basic availability only) or go back to check the device address.

reconfigure.title: Update address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address or hostname for {name}. Use this if the adapter has moved to a different address on your network.

data_description.host: The new IP address or hostname of the powerline adapter

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check the IP address and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid password. Check the password and try again.
error.host_in_use: Another TP-Link Powerline entry already uses this address.
error.cannot_verify: Connected to the device, but could not read its MAC address to confirm it is the same adapter. Try again.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The adapter address has been updated.
abort.wrong_device: The device at that address is a different powerline adapter. Check the address and try again.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a configured TP-Link Powerline adapter.
